name: StockFile
description: Metadata for an Adobe Stock file

title.description: Title of the stock file as provided by the contributor

creator_name.description: Display name of the file's creator/contributor

creator_id.description: Unique identifier of the creator on Adobe Stock

country_name.description: Country of origin of the creator

width.description: Original width of the file in pixels

height.description: Original height of the file in pixels

media_type_id.description: Numeric identifier for the media type (1=photo, 2=illustration, 3=vector, 4=video, 6=3D, 7=template)

content_type.description: MIME type of the stock file

keywords.description: List of keywords describing the file content

comp_url.description: URL of the watermarked comp image for preview purposes

thumbnail_width.description: Width of the thumbnail image in pixels

thumbnail_height.description: Height of the thumbnail image in pixels

is_licensed.description: Licensing status of the file for the authenticated user

vector_type.description: Vector file subtype (svg or zip) if applicable

nb_results.description: Total number of results matching the search query (on first item only)
